name: Skull Rock
summary: At Skull Rock, Burning Blade cultists gather in Durotar's eastern coastal cliffs. East of Orgrimmar, they plot against Thrall's Horde.

sections.title: A Den of Cultists
sections.body: In northeastern Durotar, Burning Blade cultists gather beneath the crags at Skull Rock. Dark cultists, fel-worshipping orcs, and summoners meet in its winding tunnels. There they practice demonic arts and plot against the young Horde. The warlock Gazz'uz leads them, and their work threatens Orgrimmar's nearby gates and travelers along the eastern shore.

faq.answer: Skull Rock is a cave system along northeastern Durotar's coast. Burning Blade cultists use its natural cover to plot against Thrall's Horde.
The Burning Blade controls Skull Rock. The orc warlock Gazz'uz leads the cult from the cave's deepest chamber.

faq.q: Why does the Horde care about this cave?
faq.answer: Skull Rock lies close to Orgrimmar and threatens the Horde's security. The Burning Blade seeks to undermine Thrall's new realm and return the orcs to demonic servitude.

angles.text: As a warlock, you can see demonic influence spreading through Skull Rock. Thrall's Horde seeks to root it out and control the cave.
As a member of the Horde, you know clearing Skull Rock's cultists helps secure Durotar's coastal approaches. It also protects Orgrimmar from subversion within.
